advice.payment_to_personal_account: Never send money to a personal mobile wallet or bank account. A legitimate organisation collects payment through a defined process, with a receipt.
advice.guarantee_language: Nobody can guarantee a visa. Hearing that promise is itself the warning — do not pay.
advice.cash_payment_requested: Cash leaves no evidence and is very hard to recover. Do not hand over a single taka without a receipt.
advice.visa_class_inconsistent: You cannot work on a visit visa or a so-called “free visa”. Do not travel for work without the correct work visa or permit.
advice.agency_not_licensed: Ask for the agency's licence number and check it. Never pay recruitment money to an agency without an active licence.
advice.cost_above_declared: Every job has a maximum lawful cost to you. If more is demanded, do not pay it — report it.
advice.contract_differs_from_offer: Compare the final contract against the salary and role you were shown. If they differ, get help before signing.
advice.offer_document_unverifiable: A logo or a stamp does not make a document real. Confirm directly with the issuing organisation through its official channel.

site.heroLead: Whether an opportunity abroad is real, what it actually costs, who you are paying and why — in one place, checked against official sources.

site.actionsTitle: What would you like to do?
site.statsTitle: What is on the platform today
site.statsNote: Job, employer and agency records are demo data — this is not real recruitment. The country, route and official-source registries are real.
site.howLead: Four steps. At each one you know what is happening, why, and what comes next.
site.how1Body: Enter a verification ID, an agency licence, or paste the message. We compare it against verified records — and tell you what we could not check.
site.how2Body: Who pays what, who receives it, under which rule, and whether it is refundable — every line separately. No hidden fees.
site.how3Body: Which route is open to you is computed from versioned rules and official sources. When we cannot be sure, we say "we don't know" instead of guessing.
site.how4Body: Money moves through a licensed financial institution and is released only against a verified milestone. Every payment leaves a receipt.
site.trustLead: These are constraints, not features — and they are enforced in code.
site.trust1: You see every known cost before you commit to anything.
site.trust2: Who earns each fee is never hidden from you.
site.trust3: Nobody can pay to rank higher in what you are shown.
site.trust4: Your personal data is never sold.
site.trust5: AI can explain a result; it can never make something "verified".
site.trust6: An organisation cannot delete a complaint made against it.
site.guidesLead: Free to read, no account needed. Every fact carries its official source and the time it was last verified.
site.guideCountriesBody: Which routes exist for each country, what they require, and where that country stands right now.
site.guideOccupationsBody: Where your trade is in demand, what qualifications it takes, and what the pay looks like.
site.guideSafetyBody: Eight recognisable traps — what to stop at, and exactly what to do instead.
site.orgLead: Separate surfaces are being built for foreign employers, licensed agencies, institutions and government offices.
site.orgEmployersBody: A verified candidate pool, evidence of skills, transparent recruitment costs and a compliance record.
site.orgAgenciesBody: Demand management, digital contracts, document workflow and audit-ready records.
site.orgGovernmentBody: Less informal cash leakage, faster complaint investigation, and real data on what migration costs.
site.orgStatus: These portals are not built yet. These pages describe what is being built — no partnership is claimed.
site.faq1A: No. It does not replace government services. BMET and OEP run their own processes and those are final. We read official sources and explain them.
site.faq2Q: Can you get me a visa?
site.faq2A: No, and nobody can. Visa, admission and work-permit decisions belong to the destination country's authority. Anyone promising otherwise is showing you the clearest sign of fraud.
site.faq3A: The core worker-safety features are free or very low cost. Lawful costs — government fees, medical, passport — are itemised separately, and we say who receives each one.
site.faq4A: No. Personal data is never sold or passed on as a lead. What an organisation can see depends on your permission, and you can withdraw it at any time.
site.faq5Q: What if I have been cheated?
site.faq5A: Report it as early as you can and keep your evidence — messages, receipts, documents. The organisation complained about cannot delete the complaint. The help page lists the next steps.
site.faq6A: No — this is under construction. Countries, routes and official sources are real; job, employer and agency records are demo data and clearly labelled. Never pay anyone on the basis of demo data.
site.ctaLead: One verification ID or one pasted message is enough. In seconds you will see what matched and what did not.
site.footerLegalNote: This platform guarantees no visa, no admission and no job.
site.aboutLead: Infrastructure that makes the path from Bangladesh to work or study abroad understandable, verifiable, costed honestly — and much harder to exploit.
site.studyLead: Routes, costs and preparation for studying abroad. This part is still being built — what exists is verified, and what does not exist we say plainly.
site.aboutWhy1: Much of the journey from Bangladesh is already digital. What is missing is trust: whether the job is real, what it should cost, and where the money actually goes.
site.aboutWhy2: A worker still hears about a job from an unregistered intermediary, pays cash without a receipt, and sees the contract for the first time at the airport.
site.aboutWhy3: The goal is narrow and specific: make the lawful path easier than the informal one.
site.aboutBuildBody: The country and route registry, the official-source registry, the deterministic eligibility engine, the cost breakdown, fraud detection, milestone-controlled payment accounting, and the family co-pilot.
site.aboutNotBuiltBody: Government integrations, real money movement through a licensed institution, the full study engine, and the employer / agency / government portals. They are absent — and we do not pretend otherwise.
site.legalNot1: Not a government service, and not a replacement for BMET/OEP.
site.legalNot2: Not a recruiting agency and not an education agent.
site.legalNot3: Not an immigration lawyer and not a visa consultancy.
site.legalNot4: Not a bank, wallet, remittance service or lender — we do not hold your money.
site.legalNot5: No government or institutional partnership is claimed.
site.legalStatusBody: Final terms and a privacy notice will be published after legal review, and reviewed in Bangla. Until then, do not enter real personal data here.
site.orgNotAvailable: This portal is not open yet.
site.orgEmployersNeed: Valid company registration, a job demand, contract terms, and an explicit statement of who bears the recruitment cost.
site.orgAgenciesNeed: An active recruiting licence, a verifiable job demand, and a legal basis for every taka collected from a worker.
site.orgGovernmentNeed: A legal basis for data sharing, access scoped to your authority, and an audit record of every access.
site.studyStatus: This section has the structure for verified institutions and courses, but all of the data is demo. Do not make a real admission or tuition decision from it.
